dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Initiating Voice Log.
开始记录。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
This is Control Team Captain Agent Faust. Logging today's Work records.
控制部队长浮士德，开始记录今日工作时间日志。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
My current location is... the Lobotomy Corporation Headquarters. Upper Layer, Control Team Department.
我现在的位置是……脑叶公司本部。上层控制部。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
It has been 9 days since the Manager's first day at work. 3 days have passed since the Information Team Department opened.
工作开始已有9天，自情报部开放已过了3天。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The Clerks are almost all here... It is quite busy.
由于再过不久文职人员们便能结束工作……因此略微有些嘈杂。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
This voice log will resume when Management Work begins. Pausing the recording.
开始管理任务时，将会再次开始录音。记录暂停。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
... Resuming Voice Log.
……再次开始记录。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
I am... currently headed to educate our new hires.
现在……我正在前去培训新员工的路上。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Also, the Manager has requested that I be assigned to manage the new Abnormality we received yesterday. It appears that the personnel newly deployed to the Control Team has expired.
另外，主管委托我去管理昨天收容的新异想体。看来，原本部署在控制部的员工已经阵亡了。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
It seems that we've hired a new employee...
虽然我们在招募新员工……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Oh, Excuse me... (Shuffling noises)
啊，请稍等……（沙沙作响）

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Hello, Jacob. What is it? You are hesitating outside the containment unit.
雅各布，是你啊。为什么在收容单元门口徘徊……

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
Ah, Team Captain Faust... I-It's my first assignment, and I'm... a bit scared....
啊，浮士德队长……我、我这是第一次工作……稍微有点……害怕……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
There is no cause for concern, Jacob. The Abnormality assigned to you is likely to be the safest Abnormality here.
请安心，雅各布。这支部里没有什么异想体比你负责的更为安全的了。

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
But... Its name here, look... It's really intimidating...
但是……这个，记录里写着的名字很可怕……

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds...
一罪与百善……

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
Team Captain! W-what happens if I get unlucky and the thing decides to commit that one Sin against me? I-I don't... I still haven't...
队长！要是那一罪落到我头上该怎么办啊？我、我还……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Relax. That is not how this Abnormality behaves.
请冷静。那异想体不会如此行动。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Peruse the Abnormality Details, and conduct Insight or Attachment Works. And nothing will happen.
只要遵照异想体图鉴里所写的进行洞察和沟通工作，就什么都不会发生。

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
R-really...?
真、真的吗……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Faust does not lie.
浮士德不会说谎。

dataList.title:
Level 1 Agent
1级 员工
dataList.content:
O-okay. Thank you, Team Captain.
我、我明白了……非常感谢，队长。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
... We are running somewhat behind schedule. Jacob is one of the newest hires assigned to the Control Team. It appears he was unnecessarily intimidated by a brief description of the Abnormality.
……花费了一些时间。雅各布是刚被部署到控制部的新员工，对异想体的说明似乎让他不必要的恐慌了。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
I suppose this is a part of a Team Captain's job. I am certain that the Manager will be understanding.
这就是队长的工作之一吧……相信主管一定也能够理解。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Then... I will continue this recording once I arrive at the containment unit.
那么……移动到收容单元前时将会再次开始录音。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Testing, testing. Resuming Voice Log.
啊、啊。再次开始记录。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
My arrival was delayed beyond my initial predictions... I had a run-in with Ms. Malkuth, and had the pleasure of exchanging a few words with her.
比预计到达时间稍迟了一些……我和Malkuth女士面谈了一会儿。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
She inquired about the Work we had planned for the day, so I made an impromptu report.
她问到了今日进行的管理工作的相关事宜，我对此进行了报告。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
While it was unexpected that she wanted to know the expected completion time down to the seconds, I believe that records were helpful in giving her a satisfactory answer.
虽然没有料到她会要求精确到秒的预定完成时间，但多亏了有所记录，我才得以交付令人满意的回答。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
She is a Sephirah, after all. She is responsible for an entire department. Her demands are not entirely unreasonable.
毕竟她是负责管理整个部门的……相当于部长的Sephirah，所以也不是不能理解。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Moving on... This is the containment unit of T-01-54, also known as the Forsaken Murderer.
总之……这里是T-01-54，俗称被遗弃的杀人魔的收容单元前。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
According to the prior records... As long as the Work results are good, there shouldn't be any difficulties with managing this Abnormality.
根据至今为止的记录……只要工作结果不为差，就不会出现问题。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Hm... (Sounds of flipping through papers) Work records show that the employee previously assigned to this Abnormality conducted Repression Works.
嗯……（翻阅文件的声音）工作记录显示，之前分配到此的员工对其进行了压迫工作。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
... Which resulted in the overproduction of NE-Box. The Abnormality's head transformed into something akin to a metallic substance, which it used to crush the employee to death... Hm.
结果……由于NE-BOX产生太多，它的头变成了类似于金属的东西……随后将那名员工的头敲碎致死……呼。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Not many would understand the process by which a person's head transforms from flesh to metal. But that ineffability is simply the nature of Abnormalities.
没有几人能正确理解其头部变成金属的原理，但这种不可知性才是异想体的特点。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
This record at least informed me that avoiding Repression Work on this Abnormality would be preferable.
至少通过记录可知，避免进行压迫工作较为妥当。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Even if something were to happen... I have an E.G.O Suit resistant against RED damage, so I foresee little trouble ahead.
万一发生了什么……我也有物理抗性较高的E.G.O护甲，应该没有问题。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
I will continue this documentation once the Work is complete.
那么，工作完成后再进行录音。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
... This is Faust.
……这里是浮士德。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The Work was successful.
工作成功了。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The Abnormality was observed muttering something to itself. It shuddered with anxiety and refused to look away from the floor. A proper communication was deemed difficult.
观察到它一边自言自语，一边低着头不安地颤抖，判断难以与其进行理性对话。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
It looked rather emaciated, so I attempted to perform an Instinct Work by providing it food items that humans find useful.
其看上去十分憔悴，于是我尝试提供对人类有营养价值的食物，对其进行本能工作。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The results are encouraging. I will record that Instinct Work is effective for this Abnormality.
结果为优。可以记录下本能工作对该异想体有效。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
But... I have not observed any signs of its head turning into metal, nor am I any closer to learning the mechanics behind that phenomenon.
但是……并未确认到它的头变为金属的理由或征兆。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Considering this E.G.O weapon was extracted from the Abnormality in question, it seems evident that the Abnormality's characteristics are at least partially carried over to the shape and particularities of the E.G.O weapon.
通过从该异想体提取出的E.G.O装备的特征可知，异想体的特性也会影响E.G.O装备的形态与特性。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Ah, the siren...
啊，警报声……

dataList.title:
Lobotomy Corporation
脑叶公司
dataList.content:
[WARNING. ORDEAL OF GREEN DAWN ALERT. SUPPRESSION PERSONNEL FROM ALL DEPARTMENTS MUST IMMEDIATELY ASSEMBLE AT THE BOTTOM RIGHT ELEVATOR OF THE UPPER LAYER.]
[警报，出现绿色的黎明考验。启动一级警报。请各部门负责镇压的员工立即移动至上层最下方右侧的电梯。]

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The Manager's orders have arrived via the devices. ... It is time for the Ordeals already, then.
终端传来了主管的召集命令。……已经到了会出现考验的时候了。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Each employee is equipped with a device that displays orders from the Manager in text form. The devices must be checked often as the orders are rather frequent.
主管下达的命令会像这样显示在员工所持的终端上。由于命令十分频繁，因此需要时刻确认。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
I must go and assist them in Suppressing this Ordeal.
我也将前去与他们会合以镇压考验。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
I am not particularly concerned. Maybe this Ordeal will be Suppressed before Faust even gets there.
我并没有特别担心。说不定在浮士德到达之前考验就会被镇压。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
The Manager does not yet know... but the Ordeal of Green Dawn is quite insignificant compared to what is to come.
这次的主管应该还不知道……黎明的考验真的只是冰山一角，真的……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
... Hm, no. I must hold my tongue, lest I risk confusing any other individual who will be listening to this recording.
……不。或许这些信息会让其他查看这篇记录的人感到混乱，因此还是不说为好。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Faust is... determined to struggle, to survive the remaining 41 days of Work.
只是……浮士德决心熬过剩下的41天的工作，存活到最后……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
And I will leave it at that.
记录到此为止吧。

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Well, then...
那么……

dataList.title:
Control Team Captain
控制部 队长
dataList.content:
Faust, ending the Voice Log.
浮士德，记录完毕。
